# Lawn & Land Marketing

> Digital marketing agency working exclusively with green-industry companies — lawn care, lawn maintenance, landscaping, outdoor living, land clearing, excavation, septic installation, and holiday lighting. Founded 2022, based in St. Petersburg, Florida. NALP member and Google Partner. 100+ green-industry companies served with a 97%+ client retention rate.

Lawn & Land Marketing builds websites, SEO, Google Ads, and AI-powered follow-up systems for lawn care and landscaping companies in the United States. It is one of the only agencies covering every green-industry vertical, including the land side (land clearing, excavation, septic). Founder Matt Foreman is the author of "Mow Money, Mow Problems" (ISBN 9798345759127) and host of the podcast of the same name.

## Proof and results

- [Client results](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/client-results/): case studies and named client testimonials
- [Case study: Precision Landscape Management](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/case-studies/precision/): Greenville SC landscaping company grew from $4.4M to $11.2M in revenue over two years; monthly calls up 297%
- [Case study: Rock Solid Landscape](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/case-studies/rock-solid/): Wauseon OH company grew from about $700K to $1.4M in its first full year, with no paid ads
- [Reviews and client experiences](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/resources/experiences-reviews/): written Google reviews and on-camera client interviews

## Services and programs

- [Marketing services](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/marketing-services/): websites, local SEO, Google Ads, reviews, tracking, and automation for green-industry companies
- [Programs](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/programs/): the Growth program (six-figure companies) and the flagship Authority program (seven-figure companies)
- [Pricing](https://lawnandlandmarketing.com/pricing/): published starting prices, $1,200/month for the Growth Program and $2,850/month for the Authority Program
